event_records.description: The third water-main burst of the morning occurs in Riverton.

mayor_of_riverton.name: Mayor of Riverton
mayor_of_riverton.persona_brief:
You are Mayor of Riverton.
The mayor is aware of the three water-main bursts this morning and is considering whether to issue a public statement. The mayor has no fixed policy on such statements and weighs factors like public concern, media attention, and operational updates from the water department.

resolution.question: Will the mayor of Riverton issue any public statement about the water-main failures within 48 hours of this morning's third burst?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the mayor of Riverton issued any public statement about the water-main failures before 2026-08-14T07:00:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
